sequence.py: Tā fáng, běnlái shì fángzi tā le.
sequence.en: 塌房 originally just meant a house collapsed.

sequence.cn: 粉丝喜欢一个明星，心里就像给他盖了一座房子。
sequence.py: Fěnsī xǐhuan yí ge míngxīng, xīnlǐ jiù xiàng gěi tā gài le yí zuò fángzi.
sequence.en: When a fan loves a star, it's like they've built a whole house for that person inside their heart.

sequence.cn: 明星一出事，那座房子就塌了——这就是塌房。
sequence.py: Míngxīng yì chū shì, nà zuò fángzi jiù tā le — zhè jiù shì tā fáng.
sequence.en: The moment something bad happens to the star, that house collapses — and that is 塌房.

sequence.cn: 我表姐追一个明星，追了整整五年。
sequence.py: Wǒ biǎojiě zhuī yí ge míngxīng, zhuī le zhěngzhěng wǔ nián.
sequence.en: My cousin followed a star — five straight years of it.

sequence.cn: 那天早上她还在被窝里，手机就响个不停。
sequence.py: Nà tiān zǎoshang tā hái zài bèiwō lǐ, shǒujī jiù xiǎng ge bù tíng.
sequence.en: That morning she was still under the covers when her phone wouldn't stop buzzing.

sequence.cn: 打开一看，热搜第一是他的名字，后面跟着两个字：出轨。
sequence.py: Dǎkāi yí kàn, rèsōu dì-yī shì tā de míngzi, hòumian gēnzhe liǎng ge zì: chū guǐ.
sequence.en: She opened it: number one on the trending list was his name, followed by two words — cheating.

sequence.cn: 她一句话没说，把墙上的海报一张一张揭了下来。
sequence.py: Tā yí jù huà méi shuō, bǎ qiáng shàng de hǎibào yì zhāng yì zhāng jiē le xiàlái.
sequence.en: Without a word, she peeled the posters off the wall one by one.

sequence.cn: 抽屉里三千多块的周边，一件也没舍得扔。
sequence.py: Chōuti lǐ sān qiān duō kuài de zhōubiān, yí jiàn yě méi shěde rēng.
sequence.en: The three-thousand-plus yuan of merch in the drawer — she couldn't bring herself to throw a single piece out.

sequence.cn: 她说：房子塌了，可那五年的开心，是真的。
sequence.py: Tā shuō: fángzi tā le, kě nà wǔ nián de kāixīn, shì zhēn de.
sequence.en: She said: the house has collapsed, but those five years of happiness — they were real.
